$comment: Contract-shape ratchet (scripts/ci/check_contract_shape.py, ADR-0081). Numbers may only fall; raising one requires --write-baseline --reason, recorded in growth_reasons.

growth_reasons.production_lines: the UTC calendar codec moved from awaken-session-contract into the clock port's own crate so every context spells a clock reading identically

growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: merged awaken-environment-realization-contract; its 2 instances moved here, workspace total unchanged

growth_reasons.production_lines: sandbox effect fence: FenceToken succession law and SandboxEffectGuard live in the provisioning contract (capability defaults 12->1); SessionRealizationLease implements FenceToken so the generation-authority rule delegates to that one law
growth_reasons.catch_all_errors: Classify/Disposition vocabulary moved down into agent-contract so sandbox failures classify without a provisioning->runtime edge; provisioning-contract gains the typed SandboxError classes and the neutral handle-evidence codec that replaced its backend payload enums (backend nouns 10->0); SandboxError Transport/Invalid are classified failure classes carrying detail, replacing the former untyped SandboxError(String)

growth_reasons.production_lines: async_trait attributes on the five Resource Registry ports (+7 lines, no new surface)

deadline_has_passed: the one rule deciding whether a durable deadline has passed, which was previously four separate Rust spellings (two normalizing now, two not) plus one hand-written predicate per SQL query. It is contract vocabulary because the transition rules and every backend must answer that question identically, and it carries the Kani proof none of the scattered spellings could

runtime-contract retains the capability supertraits and advisor_binding_is_duplicate production kernel recorded by the prior baseline. Model recovery additionally distinguishes a completely consumed HTTP error body from success-body and stream terminal receipts; three enum/mapping lines close unknown-outcome retry ambiguity.

sandbox effect fence: FenceToken succession law and SandboxEffectGuard live in the provisioning contract (capability defaults 12->1); SessionRealizationLease implements FenceToken so the generation-authority rule delegates to that one law. Session realization exclusion: the contract-owned SessionRealizationPermit and its admission kernel (session_realization/exclusion.rs) are the one authority both the Worker slot and the co-located registry mint through, so the permit vocabulary stays in the contract while its phase driver moved to awaken-session-application. Settlement and Work-receipt derivations: the named derivation kernels the settlement and Work-receipt Kani harnesses prove against now live in the contract; they were previously inline assumptions inside the harnesses, which made the proofs assume what they were meant to establish
